publicRuntimeBehavior: Production endpoint validation and release no-stub guards remain unchanged.
testContractChanges: All three lanes and the validator require one common release invocation plus distinct lane invocation identities.
A lane result must match its final passed preflight, expected lane, source commit, invocation identities, and freshness window.
Debug physical Android E2E uses network.xpoint.deep.e2e; Release remains network.xpoint.deep.
Live acceptance is explicit not-run unless the lane is requested; a requested lane fails on missing configuration.
Windows UI acceptance is explicit not-run unless requested; the strict lane requires a real executable, real process, nonzero window, executed tests, and zero skips.
The UI automation baseline now uses the current Welcome control identifiers.
consumerActions: deep-tests-e2e must pass the same ReleaseInvocationId to all lane wrappers and Test-StrictClientEvidence.ps1 -RequireComplete.
A physical Android runner must execute the bound E2E APK on an attested dedicated managed device before Android evidence can pass.
Only top-level sanitized JSON and allowlisted Windows UI evidence may be uploaded; raw Android runner, JUnit, logcat, and screenshots remain local quarantine.
